phase_1_foundation.notes: All foundation items present. Supabase client/server configured with types. Auth pages (login/signup) exist. Root + dashboard + auth layouts present. 12 shadcn/ui components installed. Middleware with auth protection. PWA manifest configured. Next.js 16.1.4 (CLAUDE.md says 15).

phase_2_family_tree.notes: Family member CRUD complete (5 exports in family.ts). Relationships with bidirectional support (4 exports). Family tree visualization with relatives-tree library. Family + tree pages with loading states. Types fully defined. access_permissions table typed in DB but no server actions exist.

phase_3_document_ocr.notes: Document CRUD complete (4 exports). Medicine management (6 exports). Upload dialog with drag-drop and validation. GPT-4o-mini vision OCR with Indian prescription support. API route for processing (replaces edge function). Auto-interaction check post-extraction. PDF extraction stub only. Camera capture not implemented.

phase_4_drug_interactions.notes: Hybrid checking: OpenFDA primary with GPT fallback. Severity inference (contraindicated/major/moderate/minor). Auto-check after medicine extraction. Dashboard alert for unacknowledged interactions. Interactions page with medical disclaimer. Acknowledge/dismiss flow. Batch processing with rate limiting (3 pairs/500ms).

phase_5_glucose_tracking.notes: Only database schema exists (glucose_readings table fully typed in database.ts with reading_type and meal_context enums). Dashboard has a 'Log Glucose' link pointing to /dashboard/glucose which will 404. No actions, types, components, or page implemented.

phase_6_pwa_polish.notes: next-pwa v5.6.0 listed as dependency but NOT configured in next.config.js (has comment 'Phase 6'). manifest.json exists and is complete. public/icons/ directory exists but only has .gitkeep. No service worker, offline page, or install prompt component.

critical_issues.issue: Glucose tracking feature completely unimplemented - dashboard links to /dashboard/glucose which returns 404
critical_issues.fix: Implement glucose.ts actions, glucose.ts types, glucose-chart.tsx, reading-form.tsx, and glucose/page.tsx. DB schema already exists in database.types.ts.

critical_issues.issue: PWA not functional - next-pwa dependency installed but not configured, no service worker, no offline page, no app icons
critical_issues.fix: Configure withPWA in next.config.js, generate service worker, create offline fallback page, add icon files (192x192, 512x512).

critical_issues.issue: Access permissions server actions missing - access_permissions table is typed but no CRUD operations exist
critical_issues.fix: Create access-permissions.ts with getPermissions, grantPermission, revokePermission, checkPermission server actions.

warnings.issue: Camera capture component missing - only file upload dialog exists, no camera/photo capture for mobile
warnings.fix: Add camera capture component using MediaDevices API or input type=file with capture attribute.

warnings.issue: Supabase Edge Function missing - OCR processing uses Next.js API route instead
warnings.fix: Architecture difference only - API route at src/app/api/documents/[id]/process/route.ts works correctly. No action needed unless edge deployment is required.

warnings.issue: PDF extraction not supported - extractMedicinesFromPDF returns 'not yet supported'
warnings.fix: Implement PDF text extraction using pdf-parse or similar library before passing to GPT.

warnings.issue: CLAUDE.md version mismatch - states 'Next.js 15' but actual version is 16.1.4
2 console.log statements remain in production code
warnings.fix: Remove or replace with proper logging.

recommendations.reason: Database schema is ready. Dashboard already links to /dashboard/glucose causing 404. Needs actions, types, components (chart + form), and page route.
Dependency installed, manifest exists, but next.config.js has no PWA config. Missing service worker, offline page, and icon assets makes the app non-installable.
access_permissions table is typed and ready but no server actions exist. Hierarchical access control is a key feature for family health management.

recommendations.action: Add camera capture component for mobile prescription photos
recommendations.reason: Mobile users need camera capture for prescription scanning. Currently only file upload is available.
